units.source_text: 千重子觉得父亲把问题扯远，似乎也自有道理。

en.t: Chieko felt that her father had led the question away, yet there seemed to be some reason in it after all.

units.source_text: 她说：“但是，爸爸，细看的话，不论是樟树树干也罢，

en.t: She said, "But Father, if you look closely, whether it is the trunk of the camphor tree,

units.source_text: 奇特地伸展的枝丫也罢，都令人望而生畏，

en.t: or the strangely spreading branches, they all fill you with awe,

units.source_text: 仿佛有一股巨大的力量，不是吗？”

en.t: as if there were some immense power in them, don't they?"
